system.description: The Solar's player can invoke this Charm when making a Martial Arts roll. This Charm adds one die to that roll for each mote spent, to a maximum of (Attribute + Martial Arts) dice. Characters can also use this Charm to enhance static values such as a Defense Value: roll one die per mote spent, and each success increases the effective (Attribute + Martial Arts) rating by two, raising the applicable DV by one. This Charm can be part of a Combo or used together with the Second Excellency, but it is incompatible with the Third Excellency.
